<thought>By examining the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 144.78, 132.00, 130.07 (two signals), and 127.80 (two signals). These correspond to 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbon atoms. The remaining peaks are outside the aromatic range, so they are not aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
